summary: MMTEC, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited semi-annual financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue fell to nil from $0.81 million, net loss narrowed to approximately $1.58 million from $46.43 million, with the prior period loss affected by allowances. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, providing no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing reports ordinary operating results and forward-looking statements, with no transaction, board action, or strategic initiative announced. It warrants no special-situations classification beyond a standard earnings update.
